'''R'kik D'nec punch-out''' is an undersized insert from ''[[InQuest]]'' Gamer #49 (May 1999) of {{CardLink|R'kik D'nec, Hero Of The Dune Sea}}.<ref name="enc108" /><ref name="enc183" />

[[File:Encyclopedia 3.2 page 186.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Encyclopedia 3.2, page 186, InQuest 42 and 49.]]
[[File:InQuest 49 cover.jpg|thumb|right|220px|InQuest Gamer #49, May 1999.]]
[[File:R'Kik D'Nec InQuest punch-out.jpg|thumb|right|260px|InQuest R'kik D'nec punch-out and regular card.]]

The insert is a regular-size card with a perforated miniature. The unpunched backing carries an [[Endor Limited|Endor]] expansion advertisement.<ref name="ccg-collector" /> Issue 49 also included a 16-page SWCCG price guide, Premiere through Special Edition.<ref name="enc183" />

[[File:InQuest 49 contents.jpg|thumb|right|220px|InQuest Gamer #49 contents, May 1999.]]

<blockquote>
'''Backing'''

Get the ''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game Endor expansion this Spring!

STAR WARS CUSTOMIZABLE CARD GAME

Back of the backing: Rebel Alliance symbol with STAR WARS.

'''Punch-out / card'''

'''•R'kik D'nec, Hero Of The Dune Sea''' &nbsp; 1

A tribe of Tusken Raiders, a herd of angry banthas, a raging krayt dragon and R'kik. Minutes later, the Jawa emerged from the Dune Sea, a bantha tusk over his shoulder.

POWER 3 &nbsp; ABILITY 1

Deploys only on Tatooine. Jawa weapons deploy free on R'kik, when firing one, may add up to 3 to the total weapon destiny just drawn.
</blockquote>
